topics.title: Change of Heart: Prabhat and the Friendly Match

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how Prabhat's fear of losing shaped the way he chose and played games.
Recall the events of the friendly badminton match and how Prabhat won it unfairly.

topics.title: Change of Heart: Surya's Attitude and Sporting Spirit

concepts.learning_objective: Describe how Surya enjoyed games whether he won or lost.
Analyse how Prabhat changed and why sporting spirit matters.

topics.title: Change of Heart: Vocabulary, Past Perfect and Polite Expressions
topics.ncert_sections: Change of Heart: Let us learn, Let us speak

concepts.learning_objective: Give the meanings of words used in the story, such as phenomenon and opponent.
Use the past perfect tense to show which of two past actions happened first.
Choose suitable expressions with please, thank you and sorry for different situations.
Explain the setting, events and meaning of the poem 'The Winner'.
Identify personification and the effect of the word pattern used in the poem.

topics.title: Yoga - A Way of Life: Meaning, Origin and Recognition
topics.ncert_sections: Yoga - A Way of Life (Let us read, Let us explore)

concepts.learning_objective: State the meaning and origin of the word yoga and the role of Sage Patanjali.
Explain how yoga has come to be recognised across the world.

topics.title: Yoga - A Way of Life: Benefits; Practice and Practise
topics.ncert_sections: Yoga - A Way of Life (Let us read, Let us learn)

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the physical and mental benefits of yoga given in the chapter.
Use the noun forms practice and advice and the verb forms practise and advise correctly.
